+24V.why: 24 V +10 % steady (brick is +/-3 %: 24.72 V; OVP trips at up to 32.4 V); transient = the SMAJ24A clamp at the brick's 6.67 A, the most this rail can be handed: 35.6 V (breakdown 26.7-29.5 V; its catalogue VC is 38.9 V at 10.3 A)

+3V3.why: LMR16006: VFB max x (1 + top/bot), 1 % resistors; +5 % load-release overshoot as the transient: 0.782 V x (1 + R1/R2) -> 3.43 V max

+5V_RAW.why: LMR33630: VFB max x (1 + top/bot), 1 % resistors; +5 % overshoot; FAULT = U5's high side fails short and D9 (SMBJ5.0A) clamps at its VC while F1 clears: 1.015 V x (1 + R10/R11) -> 5.17 V max

BOOT5.why: bootstrap: SW5 + 5.5 V, held by U5

CAN1_RX.why: U2.4 (RXD) can reach its supply +3V3; U4.64 (io) can reach its supply +3V3

CAN2_RX.why: U3.4 (R) can reach its supply +3V3; U4.35 (io) can reach its supply +3V3

CANA_H.why: bus A: dominant level of a 5 V transceiver in a SERVO42D (assumed, not known); transient = the NUP2105L's maximum breakdown either way (24 V stand-off, so the +24 V conductor beside it in the same 4-wire trunk is a level it stands, not one it clamps); FAULT = that conductor shorted on

CANA_L.why: bus A: dominant level of a 5 V transceiver in a SERVO42D (assumed, not known); transient = the NUP2105L's maximum breakdown either way (24 V stand-off, so the +24 V conductor beside it in the same 4-wire trunk is a level it stands, not one it clamps); FAULT = that conductor shorted on

CANB_H.why: bus B: 5 V nodes; nothing above 5 V in its cable; transient = the ESD5B5.0 clamps' maximum breakdown (motor_ctrl D4 / D5, and each lever board's own)

CANB_L.why: bus B: 5 V nodes; nothing above 5 V in its cable; transient = the ESD5B5.0 clamps' maximum breakdown (motor_ctrl D4 / D5, and each lever board's own)

CB.why: bootstrap: SW + 7 V, held by U1

PWR_SW_DN.why: the power button's throw, from output_panel [output_panel.SW_SENSE: clamped by D8 (BZT52C10T, VZ max 10.6 V) behind R33+R34 = 9.4 k; +0.2 V for its 20 ohm at the transient current]

PWR_SW_UP.why: the power button's throw, from output_panel [output_panel.SW_SENSE: clamped by D8 (BZT52C10T, VZ max 10.6 V) behind R33+R34 = 9.4 k; +0.2 V for its 20 ohm at the transient current]

SW.why: buck switch node: VIN while the high side is on [= +24V+0]

SW5.why: buck switch node: VIN while the high side is on [= +24V_BUCK+0]

VBUS_NC.why: USB VBUS on the lead from the Pi; lands on a lone pad
